column3: The swipe-tracking rule is .im-toast-stack .im-toast[data-swiping], after the hover/focus fan-out, in the base rules and both reduce blocks
column4: At .im-toast[data-swiping] (0,2,0) it lost to .im-toast-stack:hover .im-toast (0,3,0), and a swipe always happens with the pointer over the stack, so the toast would sit at the fan-out offset instead of following the finger once swipe-to-dismiss is wired; the toast component always renders inside .im-toast-stack
column5: web/e2e/reduce-motion.test.ts 'a swiping toast follows the pointer over the hover fan-out': translateX(50px) with no reduce, the OS setting and the in-app setting; on main it was translateY(-40px) in all three
